settings.text: Bring a touch of modern elegance to your space with this 2-tier Coffee Side Table. Designed with a stylish silhouette, it combines a smooth marble-look top and a matching lower shelf with a slim gold metal frame for a clean, luxurious appearance. The two-tier layout offers practical storage and display space for books, candles, decor, and everyday essentials, making it perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, lounges, and reading corners. Its compact footprint and open design help it fit beautifully into small spaces without feeling heavy or cluttered. This table works equally well as a coffee table, side table, or accent table, adding both function and visual appeal to contemporary interiors.

settings.heading: Product Specification
settings.row_content:
• Dual-Shelf Storage: The top and bottom shelves give you two useful surfaces for display and storage, helping keep your space organized.
  • Shape: The form softens the look of the room and makes it ideal beside sofas, armchairs, or beds.
  • Decor-Friendly Layout: Perfect for styling with books, candles, vases, trays, or small plants.
  • Compact Footprint: Designed to fit in smaller living spaces while still offering practical surface area.
  • Versatile Use: Can be used as a coffee table, sofa side table, nightstand, or accent table.

settings.heading: Material
settings.row_content:
• Gold Metal Frame: The slim metallic frame gives the table a refined luxury finish and modern appeal.
  • Marble-Look Surfaces: The top and lower shelf create a polished, high-end look while remaining easy to maintain.
  • Contemporary Aesthetic: Suits modern, glam, minimalist, and hotel-style interiors.
  • Assembly: Typically easy to assemble in similar designs.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
• Wipe the surface regularly with a soft, dry or slightly damp microfiber cloth.
  • Use mild soap if needed, then dry immediately to maintain the finish.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals, bleach, abrasive pads, or rough scrubbing on the marble-look surface.
  • Keep hot items on coasters or mats to protect the finish from marks.
  • Clean the metal frame with a soft cloth to prevent dust buildup and preserve shine.
